output.summary: Content pack for Imvusa Furniture's core rebuild pages (Home, Services, Leather Couches, Gallery, Contact Us), built strictly from research_report v1 and site_blueprint v1 findings. Resolves the two directly-observed contact mismatches by defining one authoritative, canonical contact block (used identically on Home and Contact Us, and referenced rather than re-authored on other pages). Eliminates the duplicated Services list by presenting the 8 named services exactly once. Standardizes the fabric supplier's name as "Hertex Fabrics" throughout (correcting the "Hertext" variant). Replaces the image-only Leather Couches and Gallery pages with substantive editorial copy per the blueprint's content strategy for those pages, without inventing services, locations, certifications, or awards not present in source research. No pricing, shop, or cart copy is included, consistent with the lead-generation/consultation business model. All service and location pages carry a single consistent conversion path toward requesting a quote/consultation; no separate Get a Quote or About page copy is included in this pack since the task scope named Home, Services, Leather Couches, Gallery, and Contact Us specifically, plus any blueprint-added pages directly required to support those — canonical contact detail is centralized on Contact Us rather than duplicated.
seoArchitecture: Primary nav and URL structure mirrors the blueprint sitemap: /, /services, /leather-couches, /gallery, /contact - kept flat and shallow for a local lead-gen business, avoiding unnecessary depth.
Home (/) targets brand + broad category intent ('custom furniture George Bloemfontein', 'reupholstery South Africa') and funnels internal links to /services and /contact.

Services (/services) targets service-list intent as a single authoritative hub page listing all 8 services once (Furniture Repairs, Reupholstery, Custom Curtains, Headboards, Scatter Cushions, Leather Couches, Wallpaper, Ottomans) - resolves the duplicate-content issue found in research, which was actively harming this page's crawl/index clarity.

Leather Couches (/leather-couches) is elevated from a thin, image-only page to a substantive flagship service/editorial page targeting 'leather couch reupholstery/repair George Bloemfontein' intent, cross-linked from the Services hub's Leather Couches entry to avoid duplicate/competing pages for the same topic.

Gallery (/gallery) targets portfolio/proof-of-work intent ('furniture reupholstery examples', 'before and after') with captioned, categorized project entries instead of an unlabeled image wall, giving search engines real indexable text per project.

Contact Us (/contact) is the single source of truth for NAP (Name, Address, Phone) data for both George and Bloemfontein offices - this directly resolves the two data mismatches found in research (George phone, Bloemfontein address) and supports local SEO consistency, which search engines and directories weight heavily for multi-location businesses.

Fabric supplier name standardized to 'Hertex Fabrics' (correct spelling) across every page that mentions it, removing the 'Hertext' inconsistency identified in research, since inconsistent brand-name spelling can dilute topical relevance and looks unprofessional to both users and partners.

Meta titles/descriptions are written per-page and location-aware (mentioning both George and Bloemfontein where relevant) to support local search visibility for a two-location service business, without fabricating any additional locations.

Internal linking consistently funnels every page toward the single contact/enquiry action, matching the blueprint's 'one core conversion action' principle, rather than scattering multiple competing calls to action.
